text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse
was enveloped in anticipation and feverish excitement—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Now, today is the once-in-a-lifetime grand stage,
the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"This special race decides the pinnacle of our generation!
The grand stage that is the grandest dream
of every Umamusume and every Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious race where countless Umamusume have claimed victory in fierce battles,
and been passed down through history as the strongest of their generation!
—That is the caliber of this race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: The lineup of Umamusume running this year is so high-level, they're being called the 'Golden Generation'!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Having continued to run strong, steady races ever since his debut, he has seized the Satsuki Sho! Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Radiating a presence just as formidable as hers
is Rose Kingdom!
Engraving the name of the Rose Clan onto a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"And Rulership! Though he missed out on the Satsuki Sho,
he triumphed in the prep race and brilliantly claimed
his ticket to the Japanese Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Along with others, led by Eishin Flash,
this year's Nippon Derby is packed with top-tier talent!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
A race that will go down in history is about to begin...
You can already feel that anticipation radiating from the stands—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, lining up early was totally worth it!
Got an amazing spot!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
A Nippon Derby packed with this much top-tier talent is something you rarely ever get to see,
for real...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Pure Frenzy"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I" will also 'have fun.'
Fight... "Victoire Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heat from the grandstands
even reached all the way down to the underground tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "The race hasn't even started yet... Once it begins, it'll be on a whole different level."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I'll head out ahead.
I want an accurate grasp of today's board.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I would also like to step outside and check the atmosphere beforehand.
If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish you good luck.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. You too, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...For a while, the two quietly listened
to the murmurs of the crowd.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pisa-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly grateful.
For inviting me to the joint training—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For connecting all of us in our generation together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To gain technical skills,
and to aim for greater heights together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At first, that was all it was.
However, as we trained together, I came to understand the true essence of your prayer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Sharing the same dream, running across the track together.
How immensely empowering such a presence is."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even when my legs were completely spent,
it was because of all of you that I was able to keep taking that next step.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"That is surely why
we were able to grow this strong."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We have arrived at a grand stage
overflowing with such immense fervor."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let us chase victory and dedicate it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I race for my parents. Ruler-san for himself.
Rose-san for the House of Roses. And Pisa-san..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To everyone watching this Japan Derby...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through victory, I will unite the stands as one.
That scenery is surely my origin.
Which is why today is my—culmination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash smiled at
Victoire Pisa's quiet declaration.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"A name deeply buried until now—
I shall leave the name of 'Eishin Flash'
right here for all to remember."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the time arrived.
The moment that would decide the very pinnacle among the elites carrying this era.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
…………
Every time I hear the roar of the crowd, I am reminded.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—That day, when I witnessed for the first time
the moment people's hearts connected.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That day my parents took me to see my first race...
the sense of unity at the racetrack...
Everyone was cheering with all their might, burning with passion."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A smile naturally broke out on my face while cheering, too,
and before I knew it, my heart felt completely light...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It was the moment I began to yearn for racing.
Believing that someday, surely, I too—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
...That's why...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today... this day is surely
going to be something special.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I can hear the murmurings, can't you?
—A fervent heat, brimming with anticipation."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Uniting the stands—uniting the entire racecourse—into one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The buzz in the stands grew even louderâ
The greatest "Japanese Derby" in history was about to begin!
